name: Spanish Common Words Set 15
description: This set contains 100 frequently used Spanish words, serving as a continuation of a larger series of common Spanish vocabulary flashcards.

cards.sentence: No me gusta aquello que pasó ayer.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I don't like that which happened yesterday.

cards.sentence: A veces voy al cine con mis amigos.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Sometimes I go to the cinema with my friends.

cards.sentence: Necesito completar este informe para mañana.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I need to complete this report by tomorrow.

cards.sentence: El barco grande puede flotar en el agua.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The big boat can float on the water.

cards.sentence: El Titanic se empezó a hundir después de chocar con el iceberg.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The Titanic began to sink after hitting the iceberg.

cards.sentence: Vamos a alquilar un coche para el viaje.
cards.sentenceTranslation: We are going to rent a car for the trip.

cards.sentence: ¿Me puedes prestar tu libro por un día?
cards.sentenceTranslation: Can you lend me your book for a day?

cards.sentence: Debes devolver los libros a la biblioteca.
cards.sentenceTranslation: You must return the books to the library.

cards.sentence: Nadie te puede obligar a hacer algo que no quieres.
cards.sentenceTranslation: No one can force you to do something you don't want to.

cards.sentence: Lamento mucho lo que pasó ayer.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I deeply regret what happened yesterday.

cards.sentence: Mi padre siempre me aconseja bien.
cards.sentenceTranslation: My father always advises me well.

cards.sentence: Esa película fue horrible, no me gustó nada.
cards.sentenceTranslation: That movie was horrible, I didn't like it at all.

cards.sentence: La pantalla táctil del teléfono es muy sensible.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The phone's touch screen is very sensitive.

cards.sentence: Una lágrima corrió por su mejilla.
cards.sentenceTranslation: A tear ran down her cheek.

cards.sentence: Tengo el deseo de viajar por todo el mundo.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I have the desire to travel all over the world.

cards.sentence: Celebraron la victoria de su equipo con mucha alegría.
cards.sentenceTranslation: They celebrated their team's victory with great joy.

cards.sentence: La derrota fue difícil de aceptar para el equipo.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The defeat was hard for the team to accept.

cards.sentence: Mi intención era ayudarte, no molestarte.
cards.sentenceTranslation: My intention was to help you, not to bother you.

cards.sentence: Tenemos un plan para el fin de semana.
cards.sentenceTranslation: We have a plan for the weekend.

cards.sentence: A veces es difícil distinguir el sueño de la realidad.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Sometimes it's difficult to distinguish dream from reality.

cards.sentence: Hay que tener fe en tiempos difíciles.
cards.sentenceTranslation: One must have faith in difficult times.

cards.sentence: Ser bilingüe es una gran ventaja en el mercado laboral.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Being bilingual is a great advantage in the job market.

cards.sentence: Una desventaja de vivir en la ciudad es el ruido.
cards.sentenceTranslation: A disadvantage of living in the city is the noise.

cards.sentence: La industria automotriz es muy importante en este país.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The automotive industry is very important in this country.

cards.sentence: Esta es un área protegida para la fauna.
cards.sentenceTranslation: This is a protected area for wildlife.

cards.sentence: Necesito más espacio en mi habitación.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I need more space in my room.

cards.sentence: Este material es muy resistente al agua.
cards.sentenceTranslation: This material is very water resistant.

cards.sentence: Me gusta comer una manzana roja cada día.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I like to eat a red apple every day.

cards.sentence: El plátano es una fruta muy nutritiva.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The banana is a very nutritious fruit.

cards.sentence: Las uvas moradas son mis favoritas.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Purple grapes are my favorite.

cards.sentence: Este té tiene sabor a limón.
cards.sentenceTranslation: This tea has a lemon flavor.

cards.sentence: La pera es una fruta dulce y jugosa.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The pear is a sweet and juicy fruit.

cards.sentence: Me encanta el helado de fresa.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I love strawberry ice cream.

cards.sentence: Las cerezas son una fruta deliciosa de verano.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Cherries are a delicious summer fruit.

cards.sentence: La sandía es perfecta para refrescarse en verano.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Watermelon is perfect for cooling down in summer.

cards.sentence: El melón dulce es mi postre preferido.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Sweet melon is my favorite dessert.

cards.sentence: La piña es una fruta tropical.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Pineapple is a tropical fruit.

cards.sentence: El zumo de mango es muy refrescante.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Mango juice is very refreshing.

cards.sentence: Me gusta poner aguacate en mis tostadas.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I like to put avocado on my toast.

cards.sentence: Añade pepino a tu ensalada para darle frescura.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Add cucumber to your salad for freshness.

cards.sentence: Las zanahorias son buenas para la vista.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Carrots are good for eyesight.

cards.sentence: La lechuga es la base de muchas ensaladas.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Lettuce is the base of many salads.

cards.sentence: El ajo da mucho sabor a la comida.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Garlic adds a lot of flavor to food.

cards.sentence: Guarda los juguetes en la caja.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Put the toys in the box.

cards.sentence: Tengo la ropa doblada en el cajón.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I have the clothes folded in the drawer.

cards.sentence: Hay un cuadro muy bonito en la pared.
cards.sentenceTranslation: There is a very beautiful painting on the wall.

cards.sentence: Necesito un teclado nuevo para mi ordenador.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I need a new keyboard for my computer.

cards.sentence: La pantalla del televisor es muy grande.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The TV screen is very big.

cards.sentence: La impresora no tiene tinta.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The printer is out of ink.

cards.sentence: Se me cayó la cartera al suelo.
cards.sentenceTranslation: My wallet fell to the floor.

cards.sentence: Ponte la chaqueta que hace frío.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Put on your jacket, it's cold.

cards.sentence: Él llevaba un traje elegante para la boda.
cards.sentenceTranslation: He was wearing an elegant suit for the wedding.

cards.sentence: Usa una esponja para lavar los platos.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Use a sponge to wash the dishes.

cards.sentence: Necesito hilo y aguja para coser el botón.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I need thread and a needle to sew the button.

cards.sentence: Ten cuidado con la aguja, pincha mucho.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Be careful with the needle, it pricks a lot.

cards.sentence: La botella es de vidrio, ten cuidado de no romperla.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The bottle is made of glass, be careful not to break it.

cards.sentence: Los niños juegan con la arena en la playa.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The children play with the sand on the beach.

cards.sentence: Había mucho humo saliendo de la chimenea.
cards.sentenceTranslation: There was a lot of smoke coming out of the chimney.

cards.sentence: La hierba del jardín está muy verde.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The grass in the garden is very green.

cards.sentence: Le regaló un hermoso ramo de flores.
cards.sentenceTranslation: He gave her a beautiful bouquet of flowers.

cards.sentence: Mi abuelo tiene una barba blanca y larga.
cards.sentenceTranslation: My grandfather has a long white beard.

cards.sentence: Mi padre se afeita el bigote cada semana.
cards.sentenceTranslation: My father shaves his mustache every week.

cards.sentence: Se golpeó el pecho al caer.
cards.sentenceTranslation: He hit his chest when he fell.

cards.sentence: Le dolía el vientre después de comer tanto.
cards.sentenceTranslation: His belly ached after eating so much.

cards.sentence: La bailarina movía las caderas al ritmo de la música.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The dancer moved her hips to the rhythm of the music.

cards.sentence: Se lesionó el muslo mientras corría.
cards.sentenceTranslation: He injured his thigh while running.

cards.sentence: Siente un calambre en la pantorrilla.
cards.sentenceTranslation: He feels a cramp in his calf.

cards.sentence: Me pinté las uñas de rojo.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I painted my nails red.

cards.sentence: Mi yerno es muy amable con toda la familia.
cards.sentenceTranslation: My son-in-law is very kind to the whole family.

cards.sentence: Mi nuera cocina la mejor paella.
cards.sentenceTranslation: My daughter-in-law cooks the best paella.

cards.sentence: Mi padrastro es muy bueno conmigo.
cards.sentenceTranslation: My stepfather is very good to me.

cards.sentence: La madrastra de Cenicienta era malvada.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Cinderella's stepmother was wicked.

cards.sentence: Mi hijo tiene un hijastro de su matrimonio anterior.
cards.sentenceTranslation: My son has a stepson from his previous marriage.

cards.sentence: Su hijastra es una estudiante muy aplicada.
cards.sentenceTranslation: His stepdaughter is a very diligent student.

cards.sentence: Mi hermanastro y yo nos llevamos muy bien.
cards.sentenceTranslation: My stepbrother and I get along very well.

cards.sentence: Su hermanastra es mayor que ella.
cards.sentenceTranslation: His stepsister is older than her.

cards.sentence: Mi bisabuelo vivió hasta los cien años.
cards.sentenceTranslation: My great-grandfather lived to be a hundred years old.

cards.sentence: Mi bisabuela siempre me contaba historias antiguas.
cards.sentenceTranslation: My great-grandmother always told me old stories.

cards.sentence: Su tatarabuelo emigró de Europa.
cards.sentenceTranslation: His great-great-grandfather emigrated from Europe.

cards.sentence: El baño está al final del pasillo.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The bathroom is at the end of the hallway.

cards.sentence: Coloca los libros en la estantería.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Place the books on the bookshelf.

cards.sentence: Hay una alfombra persa en el salón.
cards.sentenceTranslation: There is a Persian rug in the living room.

cards.sentence: Cierra las cortinas para que no entre la luz.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Close the curtains so the light doesn't come in.

cards.sentence: Hay muchos cojines cómodos en el sofá.
cards.sentenceTranslation: There are many comfortable cushions on the sofa.

cards.sentence: Necesito un martillo y un clavo para colgar el cuadro.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I need a hammer and a nail to hang the painting.

cards.sentence: Usa este pincel para pintar los detalles pequeños.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Use this paintbrush to paint the small details.

cards.sentence: Tengo que comprar un borrador nuevo para mi lápiz.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I have to buy a new eraser for my pencil.

cards.sentence: Necesito un sello para enviar esta carta.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I need a stamp to send this letter.

cards.sentence: Recibí un paquete grande por correo.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I received a large package by mail.

cards.sentence: Hay una gran similitud entre ambos casos.
cards.sentenceTranslation: There is a great similarity between both cases.

cards.sentence: El origen de la palabra es desconocido.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The origin of the word is unknown.

cards.sentence: Nuestro destino de vacaciones es la playa.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Our vacation destination is the beach.

cards.sentence: Bajo ninguna circunstancia debes abrir la puerta.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Under no circumstances should you open the door.

cards.sentence: ¿Cuál es el motivo de tu visita?
cards.sentenceTranslation: What is the reason for your visit?

cards.sentence: Debemos mostrar respeto por los mayores.
cards.sentenceTranslation: We must show respect for elders.

cards.sentence: Su enfado era evidente por su tono de voz.
cards.sentenceTranslation: His anger was evident from his tone of voice.

cards.sentence: Fue su culpa, no la mía.
cards.sentenceTranslation: It was his fault, not mine.

cards.sentence: Te voy a contar un secreto, pero no se lo digas a nadie.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I'm going to tell you a secret, but don't tell anyone.

cards.sentence: Este proyecto es un gran desafío para nosotros.
cards.sentenceTranslation: This project is a big challenge for us.
